name: esquerrapp-rules-tests
description: Dev-only test suite for EsquerrApp: the shard router, the security rules and the Cloud Functions. Self-contained (does not touch the app's root package.json). The rules and functions suites need the Firebase Emulator Suite (Java) to actually run.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:unit: mocha shard.test.js router.test.js utils.test.js navigation.test.js availability.test.js context.test.js readiness.test.js quota.test.js readiness-engine.test.js layout.test.js seed-add-team.test.js seed-multi-team.test.js archive.test.js training.test.js reminders.test.js tactic-boards.test.js --exit
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project=demo-esquerrapp "mocha functions.test.js wipe.test.js teams.test.js --timeout 120000 --exit"
